title: Mirror3D
cue: flat mirrors and reflective floors that show the scene
summary: A flat mirror that reflects the real scene, moving characters included, from a second camera: wall mirrors, polished floors, still pools, and shop windows.
useWhen: A flat surface must show a true reflection of the scene: a bathroom or dance-studio mirror, a marble or wet floor, or a window at night, where a ReflectionProbe is too blurry or shows no characters.
avoidWhen: The surface is curved or rough, which a ReflectionProbe or the sky reflection covers; it is water, still or moving, which wasd-water mirrors itself; or many mirrors would be on screen at once.
